# Pillar FAC03: Investment loading, orthogonalised to value
Definition: Loading on CMA_perp, the residual of Developed CMA regressed on Developed HML over an expanding window ending at the decision date (point-in-time). Taken from the same common-set regression, shrunk by min(1, |t| / 2), relative to VWRA's. Weight 0.28 of FAC. Because CMA is orthogonalised, FAC03 measures investment exposure beyond value and sits outside the value-cluster cap. FAC01 vs FAC03 is a mandatory REC03 pair with a 0.7 threshold.
Source: Ken French Developed 5 factors (verified); yfinance (verified). Better when: higher. Informs: portfolio_mix.
Week 2026-W46.
